G (4 ea.), Price 95, 36x36 primecoat — SIDEWALL transfer grilles, top elev. 14'-8" AFF (M101 keynote 3), not ceiling.
H (3 ea.), Price 520D, 18x8 primecoat — double-deflection SIDEWALL supply registers w/ OBD, not ceiling.
I (4 ea.), Price 520D, 14x8 primecoat — double-deflection SIDEWALL supply registers w/ OBD, not ceiling. Schedule flags field-verify size.
'D' at page pt (1516,302) on M101 — this is the plumbing label 3/4" D (condensate drain), not a type-D diffuser tag. Confirmed by zoom.
'F' at (1615,354) and (1570,364) on M101 — room name labels 'TLT F / 121' and 'SHOWERS F / 122', not grille tags.
'G' at (2073,609) on M101 — gas piping line designation (— G —) in the Kilns/Craft area, not a grille tag.

3 hexagon tags on M101 with a dash instead of a letter (450 / 450 / 75 CFM) — these are the airflow tags for ceiling exhaust fans EF-1, EF-2, EF-3, which have integral grilles per M601 exhaust fan schedule note 1. No separate grille to purchase.
Single letters A/E/G/J/D/I appearing at x>2380 on M101 — sheet-notes column text and the engineer's seal / titleblock, not plan tags.
structured_output.summary:
Buy 31 ceiling air devices — all Price, all new (MD101 shows the existing ceiling supply grilles being demolished "for installation of new grille", so nothing is reused).

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS — 28 total, louvered-face square 4-cone steel, white, 4-way pattern, factory-insulated backpan, with radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal), NC 35 max:
- Type A — Price SCD, 6" round neck in a 24x24 lay-in panel — 5 ea. (75/75/75/90/130 CFM)
- Type B — Price SCD, 8" round neck in a 24x24 lay-in panel — 4 ea. (150/150/140/140 CFM)
- Type C — Price SCD, 10" round neck in a 24x24 lay-in panel — 15 ea. (250 x4, 200 x2, 300 x2, 350 x3, 375 x4)
- Type D — Price SCD, 12" round neck in a 24x24 lay-in panel — 1 ea. (500 CFM)
- Type J — Price SMD, 12x12 face with 8" round neck — 3 ea. (175/150/150 CFM). Note J is the high-capacity model with an opposed-blade damper and a FLANGED FRAME FOR SURFACE MOUNTING (hard/gyp ceiling), not a lay-in panel.
Total ceiling supply air = 6,550 CFM.

CEILING RETURN/EXHAUST GRILLES — 3 total:
- Type F — Price 80, all-aluminum 1/2" x 1/2" x 1/2" eggcrate, 24" x 24" CORE ONLY panel for lay-in ceiling, white — 3 ea. (no CFM scheduled). One serves new FCU-1 in the MP Room (M101 keynote 4 requires a new 24x24 lined plenum atop it); two are in the Mtg Room area.

TWO THINGS THAT LOOK LIKE CEILING VENTS BUT AREN'T LINE ITEMS FOR YOU:
- EF-1 and EF-2 (Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM ea.) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM) are ceiling exhaust fans that come WITH an integral grille and factory grille-mounted motion sensor — the grille is part of the fan, don't buy separate ones. Their hexagon tags on M101 carry a dash where the grille letter would be.
- 1 ea. 14" x 14" eggcrate, Price model 82, mounted in the soffit with an insect screen on the back (M101 keynote 14). Horizontal soffit-mounted, so include it if your "ceiling vent" scope covers soffits.

NOT CEILING (15 ea. sidewall, priced separately if in your scope): E = Price 95, 30x18 primecoat, 4 ea.; G = Price 95, 36x36 primecoat, 4 ea.; H = Price 520D, 18x8 primecoat, 3 ea.; I = Price 520D, 14x8 primecoat, 4 ea. All primecoat units get 2 coats of field paint — confirm color with the architect.

Two procurement cautions from the schedule: types E and I are starred "FIELD VERIFY EXACT GRILLE DIMENSION PRIOR TO ORDERING" (M101 keynote 6 says the engineer could not field-measure the existing return openings and 30x18 is approximate) — that affects the sidewall grilles, not the ceiling count. Also, M601 general note 3 requires coordinating ceiling register locations with the lighting layout, sprinklers and ceiling grid per the architectural reflected ceiling plans, so verify the lay-in vs. surface-mount frame split (A/B/C/D/F = lay-in, J = surface) against the RCP before releasing the order.

Sheets used: M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan) for the device count and CFM tags; M601 (Mechanical Legend, General Notes & Schedules) for the Grilles schedule, exhaust fan schedule and construction notes; MD101 (Mechanical Demolition Floor Plan) to confirm existing grilles are demolished rather than reused.
